name: Customer Support Triage Agent
businessPurpose: Resolve simple customer support requests in chat and route the rest to human agents.

logging.destination: Application logs, not yet forwarded to the SIEM

killSwitch.description: Manual: the on-call engineer disables the agent's service account. No tested runbook.

description: Customer-facing chat agent. It looks up order and transaction history using support documents and the CRM, drafts replies, and issues refunds of up to $50 automatically. Refunds above $50 need human approval. Conversation history is kept for each customer session.
